🗣️ Word with the traders: a far fire sent another fire grain when their stores ran thin — no tribute, no ceremony, just food on the road. That's a thing villages DO now.
🌾 Tribute wagons from Stonebridge turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)
🌾 Nothing comes from Stonebridge this week — their fields are as empty as the wagons look. Hunger isn't defiance, but the ledger doesn't know the difference. (Arrears +4,000 kcal, trust -2.)
🌾 Stonebridge's tribute comes up thin — 2,201 of 4,000 kcal. They sent everything the wagons could carry, and it wasn't enough. The shortfall rides as arrears (+1,799 kcal). (Trust -1.)
◈ SYSTEM: "One fire was a village. Two fires is a NETWORK. Coordination layer: online — tribute, demands, the long climb, all tracked now. Try not to starve twice as fast."
